name: access_queries/
summary: Standalone SQL over SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE (no app, no snapshot tables, no procedure): 5 query files, optional AQ_* table functions, a Snowflake Notebook (path A functions / path B plain queries), a Jupyter notebook, a DuckDB test.

name: Standalone queries over ACCOUNT_USAGE (no app)
summary: User -> worksheet or notebook (path A functions / path B queries) -> ACCOUNT_USAGE GRANTS_TO_USERS, GRANTS_TO_ROLES, USERS -> recursive walk -> one row per answer with shortest PATH and WAYS.

name: ARGS
summary: the SET values; MAX_DEPTH NULL = 50 (the app's MAX_HOPS)

name: G
summary: active grants to account and database roles; a database role is named DB.ROLE, as the app does

name: GR
summary: Snowflake's own grants (SNOWFLAKE.* database roles, system compute pools, ...) only with SHOW_BUILTIN

name: EDGE
summary: role links; links granted to an admin role are left out: every custom role sits under SYSADMIN

name: UR
summary: active GRANTS_TO_USERS rows (user -> role)

name: ALL_USERS
summary: every user holds PUBLIC, granted or not

name: ME
summary: joins, not IN: a NULL name would empty NOT IN

name: STARTS
summary: the user's granted roles, plus PUBLIC when it is not granted

name: WALK
summary: every simple path down; SEEN = the roles on it, so a cycle stops
